description: Get the latest available, source-timestamped value for an energy commodity. Use when the user asks about a single commodity's latest price. Accepts natural language ('brent oil', 'diesel') or API codes ('WTI_USD'). Returns price, currency, available change fields, and timestamp. For multiple commodities at once, use opa_market_overview. For price trends, use opa_get_history.

commodity.description: Commodity name or code (e.g., 'brent oil', 'natural gas', 'WTI_USD', 'diesel')

name: opa_get_price
title: Get Commodity Price
